title: Reminders name the service, and a booking made inside 24 hours does not get an instant duplicate reminder

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: runBookingReminder and the guest mails pass serviceName: null, and the cancellation notice does too, so mails say 'your session' even when a service was booked. scheduleBookingReminder enqueues at max(now, start - 24h), so a booking made 3 hours out gets a reminder minutes after its confirmation. Fix: read the service name, skip the 24 hour reminder when the confirmation is that close, and add a short reminder (1 hour) for sessions booked that late.

DONE 2026-11-21: the reminder reads service_type_id and names the service for members and guests, and the cancellation notice names it too (from the caller, else from the cancelled row). scheduleBookingReminder skips the 24 hour reminder when start minus 24h is already past, and instead enqueues one at start minus 1h when that is still at least 30 minutes away; otherwise none. A guest's reminder links to their manage page (BOOK-007).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
